title: PyTorch Insecure Deserialization via torch.load
description: Insecure deserialization in torch.load() without weights_only=True allows arbitrary code execution via crafted pickle payloads.

remediation.description: Enforce safe deserialization by adding weights_only=True

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack (DDoS Stream Cancellation)
description: Rapid reset flood exploits HTTP/2 stream cancellations to exhaust web server worker threads and CPU.

remediation.snippet:
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=bk_ratelimit:10m rate=100r/s;
limit_req zone=bk_ratelimit burst=150 nodelay;
remediation.description: Inject HTTP/2 rate limiting and burst bounds into Nginx configuration

title: Exposed Cloud / Service Access Key in Source Code
description: Hardcoded secret access keys detected in source code. Credentials must be extracted to environment variables.

remediation.description: Redact exposed cloud secret key from source code

title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Insecure Python eval()
description: Direct evaluation of dynamic input using eval() allows arbitrary Python bytecode execution.

remediation.description: Replace insecure eval() with safe ast.literal_eval()

title: CIS Benchmark 5.2.10: Root SSH Login Permitted
description: PermitRootLogin configured as 'yes' allows direct administrative SSH authentication. Prohibited by CIS Ubuntu Benchmark.

remediation.description: Disable direct root SSH login per CIS Benchmark

title: CIS Docker Benchmark 5.4: Container Running with Privileged Flag
description: Running containers with privileged=true grants all Linux capabilities and bypasses host cgroup/namespace boundaries.

remediation.description: Drop privileged mode and enforce unprivileged container execution

title: Direct PII in Unencrypted Database Column or Entity Model
description: Sensitive personal identification information (SSN, credit card, bank account) declared in database schema without column-level encryption or cryptographic hashing.

remediation.description: Enable field-level encryption per GDPR Art. 32 and PCI DSS.

title: Unredacted PII Ingestion into LLM or External AI API
description: Direct personal identifiers (SSN, password, credit card) forwarded into remote generative AI completion payloads without prior anonymization or masking.

remediation.description: Pass request payloads through privacy redactor before calling external AI model APIs.

title: Sensitive Data Infiltration via Telemetry, Analytics, or Log Dumps
description: Telemetry emitters and debug loggers outputting full request bodies or raw credentials, violating GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimization.

remediation.description: Apply data minimization filtering before logging user request data.

title: Indefinite Storage Limitation and Missing Retention Expiration
description: Personal data persistence configured with indefinite retention, null TTL, or disabled purge cron, violating GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).

remediation.description: Enforce explicit finite retention period with automated expiration purge.

title: DSAR Export or Erasure Route Authorization Bypass
description: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) export or erasure endpoints lacking authorization or account ownership verification middleware.

remediation.description: Attach ownership verification middleware to DSAR deletion and export endpoints.

title: Consent Revocation Mechanism Omission
description: Consent management workflow does not provide an automated revocation mechanism as required by GDPR Art. 7(3).

remediation.snippet: async revokeConsent(userId: string, purpose: string): Promise<void> { await this.updateConsent(userId, purpose, false); }
remediation.description: Implement automated consent revocation interface satisfying GDPR Art. 7(3).

title: Cross-Border Transfer Without Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC)
description: Third-party data sync replicates EU data subjects to third countries without verified adequacy decision or Standard Contractual Clauses.

remediation.description: Enforce verified Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers.

title: HIPAA Un-Deidentified Protected Health Information Exposure
description: Patient health records manipulated or exported without applying the 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification elements.

remediation.description: Apply HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification method (45 CFR § 164.514).

title: Autonomous High-Risk Decision Without Human Oversight
description: High-risk AI decision making (credit scoring, employment, legal eligibility) deployed without mandatory human-in-the-loop oversight.

remediation.description: Enforce human-in-the-loop oversight per EU AI Act Art. 14 and GDPR Art. 22.

title: Security Incident Response Lacks 72-Hour Regulatory Notification
description: Security incident response workflow lacks mandatory 72-hour regulatory authority escalation workflow required by GDPR Art. 33.

remediation.description: Integrate automated 72-hour supervisory authority notification playbook per GDPR Art. 33.
